protocol.head_init_seed_rule: config.head_init_seed equals config.seed in every run (explicit, recorded)
protocol.original_split_run: not part of Gate 1 (decision OI-06, 15 Nov 2026): no run on the original sorted-name split is preregistered, measured or aggregated
protocol.target_background_split: the FINAL class-split file pinned in protocol.class_split; every run must report its class_split_sha256 and class_lists_sha256
protocol.calibration_test_split: the pools file pinned in protocol.pools: disjoint halves of the val images (every second file of each class's sorted list); each run checks that its banks draw from exactly those files

aggregation.combination_rule: 'sum' only if every primary run says 'sum'; otherwise 'best'
aggregation.token_evidence: median over primary runs of vif_null_op (the H_0 block VIF); corrected (z and d divided by sqrt(VIF_null)) iff above vif_independent_max
aggregation.shared_difficulty: flagged iff at least min_runs_shared_difficulty primary runs have vif_pos_op / max(vif_null_op, 1) above vif_independent_max; never corrected by shrinkage, the remedy is the scale-mixture likelihood with the spread estimated from the VIFs; the median spread is reported; a run whose VIFs could not be measured has not assessed it (not the same as absent)
aggregation.secondary_trunks: reported only; a secondary trunk that fails marks the result 'trunk-dependent' and restricts the claim to the primary trunk; a secondary run that deviates from the frozen protocol is reported as invalid and ignored
aggregation.invalid_if: any deviation in the primary runs: self-test, a checkpoint other than the frozen primary, a configuration value other than the frozen one or a missing key, code or data listing other than the frozen ones (hashes recorded by each run), a class split or pools file other than the frozen ones, a head-initialisation seed other than the run's measurement seed, a missing provenance-sidecar hash, file or runtime record, a provenance linkage hash that is not the hash of the run's own protocol fields, a set of seeds other than the frozen one, the analysis-time code differing from the frozen hashes; the verdict the rule would have given is reported separately and decides nothing
aggregation.inconclusive_if: a primary run could not measure a required quantity (vif_null_op, op_block_tokens, d_native_centre, d_gist and d_gist_full both, null_sd_median, zroc_slope_median together with its sd-ratio fallback); one such run is enough, it is not out-voted by the others; re-run, or freeze a new version

rules.pass_all_means: sdt_adequate AND informative AND looking_closer_pays at the operating point (size op_size, alpha 1.0)
rules.deviation_policy: any difference between a run and this file is listed as a deviation; a deviation in the primary runs makes the aggregate verdict INVALID (reported, not decided); thresholds may not change after the first run on the real checkpoint
